mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% over the past month signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and corporate profit margins, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive when UNRATE < 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand growth, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 103.5 over two consecutive months indicates strengthening manufacturing output, which signals improving corporate capacity utilization and rising earnings momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive when INDPRO > 103.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter, defined as a year-over-year decline exceeding 1.0%, signals an imminent recession, triggering risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY growth < -1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% combined with a sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 307.5 signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 307.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery, increasing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 103.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
